title: Web Hosting Plans: Certificates, Free Domain, Malware Scanning and Plan Resources
content:
**Inclusions of Web Hosting Plans — policy text**

(1) Every domain hosted on any plan receives free automatically renewed domain-validated certificates where the tier includes AutoSSL, so a paid certificate under the SSL/TLS Certificates charter is optional and never required for HTTPS.

(2) A plan whose tier offers the free domain entitlement and whose first term is at least the tier's shortest free-domain term carries one free first-year domain registration, used as the Domain Registrations charter's domain and hosting bundle rule states; a plan on a 1-month term never carries it, and the entitlement is never exchanged for credit or money.

(3) On tiers that include daily malware scanning the site already has daily malware scanning, and a security plan bought for the same site under the Website Security charter is priced as that charter states for hosted sites.

(4) Plan resources — websites allowed, storage, inode limit, memory, CPU cores, entry processes, PHP workers, MySQL databases, mailboxes included, staging copies, SSH access and dedicated IP — apply from the moment the tier takes effect.

**Applied to hypothetical plans.**

- A 12-month plan on a tier offering the free domain carries one free first-year registration; the same tier bought on a 1-month term carries none, and the missing entitlement is not replaced by credit.
- A customer asking whether HTTPS on a hosted domain needs a paid certificate is answered by clause (1): on a tier with AutoSSL it does not.
- After a change of tier takes effect, the resources of the new tier apply from that moment.
